cards.ex: My thoughts are all over the place today; I can't seem to focus.
cards.exUz: Bugun fikrlarim tartibsiz; men e'tiborimni jamlay olmayapman.
cards.uzDef: Hamma joyda sochilib ketgan, tartibsiz holatda bo'lish; bir joyda emas.

cards.ex: After the party, the living room was in a complete shambles.
cards.exUz: Bazmdan keyin mehmonxona butunlay vayrona holatda edi.
cards.uzDef: Buzilgan, vayronaga aylangan, juda tartibsiz holatda.

cards.ex: Despite the challenges, we need to stick to the plan if we want to succeed.
cards.exUz: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, muvaffaqiyatga erishmoqchi bo'lsak, rejaga rioya qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirilgan narsalarga qat'iy rioya qilish, rejadan chetga chiqmaslik.

cards.ex: The manager had to crack the whip to get the project finished on time.
cards.exUz: Menejer loyihani o'z vaqtida tugatish uchun qattiq nazorat qilishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq nazorat qilish, kimnidir qattiq intizomga solish.

cards.ex: Now that the crisis is over, we can get things back on an even keel.
cards.exUz: Inqiroz tugagandan so'ng, biz hamma narsani yana barqaror holatga keltira olamiz.
cards.uzDef: Barqaror, muvozanatli va tinch holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The computer system went haywire and we lost all the data.
cards.exUz: Kompyuter tizimi ishdan chiqdi va biz barcha ma'lumotlarni yo'qotdik.
cards.uzDef: Ishdan chiqish, nazoratdan chiqish, noto'g'ri ishlash.

cards.ex: She likes to keep her kitchen in apple-pie order.
cards.exUz: U oshxonasini mukammal tartibda saqlashni yaxshi ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Juda tartibli, toza va mukammal holatda.

cards.ex: The sale turned into a free-for-all as people fought over the discounted items.
cards.exUz: Sotuv chegirmali narsalar ustida odamlar urishgani sababli bema'nilikka aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday qoida va tartib yo'q bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: The boss decided to tighten the screws after the team missed the deadline.
cards.exUz: Boshliq jamoa belgilangan muddatni o'tkazib yuborganidan keyin nazoratni kuchaytirishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Nazoratni kuchaytirish, bosimni oshirish.

cards.ex: The project started well, but it soon veered off course.
cards.exUz: Loyiha yaxshi boshlandi, lekin tez orada yo'ldan adashdi.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirilgan yo'nalishdan chetga chiqish.

cards.ex: It's important to keep a handle on your finances.
cards.exUz: Moliyangizni nazorat qilish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir ustidan nazoratni saqlab qolish, boshqarish.

cards.ex: The documents were left in disarray after the office was ransacked.
cards.exUz: Ofis talon-taroj qilingandan so'ng hujjatlar tartibsiz holatda qoldirildi.
cards.uzDef: Tartibsiz, chalkash holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: I need to straighten up my room before my parents arrive.
cards.exUz: Ota-onam kelishidan oldin xonamni to'g'rilashim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tozalash, tartibga keltirish, yaxshilash.

cards.ex: I'm determined to get that job, by hook or by crook.
cards.exUz: Men bu ishni har qanday yo'l bilan olishga qaror qildim.
cards.uzDef: Qanday bo'lsa ham, halol yoki halol bo'lmagan yo'llar bilan.

cards.ex: All that hard work went down the drain when the project was cancelled.
cards.exUz: Loyiha bekor qilinganda, barcha mashaqqatli mehnat behuda ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Befoyda sarflangan, yo'qolgan.

cards.ex: The police were called in to establish order after the riot.
cards.exUz: Tartibsizlikdan keyin tartib o'rnatish uchun politsiya chaqirildi.
cards.uzDef: Tartib va intizom o'rnatish.

cards.ex: We have a new project in the works, so stay tuned for updates.
cards.exUz: Bizda yangi loyiha ishlab chiqilmoqda, shuning uchun yangiliklarni kuzatib boring.
cards.uzDef: Hozirda ishlab chiqilayotgan yoki rejalashtirilayotgan narsa.

cards.ex: I feel like just a cog in the machine at my big company.
cards.exUz: Men o'zimni katta kompaniyamda shunchaki bir vintdek his qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Katta tizimning kichik, ammo muhim bir qismi.

cards.ex: The investigation is on the right track, and we expect to find the culprit soon.
cards.exUz: Tergov to'g'ri yo'lda ketyapti va biz tez orada aybdorni topishga umid qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri yo'nalishda ketayotgan, muvaffaqiyatga erishish ehtimoli yuqori.

cards.ex: I didn't know much about the topic, but I muddled through the presentation.
cards.exUz: Men bu mavzu haqida unchalik ko'p narsa bilmas edim, lekin taqdimotdan qandaydir o'tdim.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchilik bilan, lekin baribir qandaydir natijaga erishmoq.

cards.ex: He tends to fly off the handle when things don't go his way.
cards.exUz: U narsalar o'z yo'nalishi bo'yicha ketmasa, jahldan tushishga moyil.
cards.uzDef: Birdaniga juda g'azablanish, nazoratni yo'qotish.

cards.ex: It's impossible to get a word in edgewise when she's talking.
cards.exUz: U gapirayotganda gapga qo'shilishning iloji yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Gapirish imkoniga ega bo'lmoq, suhbatga aralasha olmoq.

cards.ex: The car started to swerve and the driver lost control.
cards.exUz: Mashina yon tomonga o'girila boshladi va haydovchi nazoratni yo'qotdi.
cards.uzDef: Nazoratni yo'qotish, vaziyatni boshqara olmaslik.

cards.ex: After the disaster, the community came together to pick up the pieces.
cards.exUz: Falokatdan so'ng, jamiyat bo'laklarni yig'ish uchun birlashdi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon vaziyatdan keyin vaziyatni tiklashga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: She runs a tight ship in her office, and everything is always organized.
cards.exUz: U o'z ofisida qattiq boshqaruvni amalga oshiradi va hamma narsa har doim tartibli.
cards.uzDef: Juda qattiq va samarali boshqaruv uslubi.

cards.ex: The new CEO is planning to shake things up and introduce some major changes.
cards.exUz: Yangi bosh direktor vaziyatni o'zgartirish va ba'zi katta o'zgarishlarni kiritishni rejalashtirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni o'zgartirish, yangi narsalarni kiritish.

cards.ex: The dancers were out of sync during the performance.
cards.exUz: Raqqosa ijro paytida sinxron emas edi.
cards.uzDef: Bir vaqtda yoki bir xil ritmda bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: Even though everyone disagreed, she stuck to her guns and defended her idea.
cards.exUz: Hamma rozi bo'lmasa ham, u o'z fikrida qat'iy turdi va o'z g'oyasini himoya qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrida qat'iy turish, pozitsiyani o'zgartirmaslik.

cards.ex: The best-laid plans often go awry, so be prepared for unexpected challenges.
cards.exUz: Eng yaxshi rejalashtirilgan narsalar ham ko'pincha noto'g'ri bo'lib chiqadi, shuning uchun kutilmagan qiyinchiliklarga tayyor bo'ling.
cards.uzDef: Eng yaxshi rejalashtirilgan narsalar ham noto'g'ri bo'lishi mumkin.

cards.ex: The new manager was able to turn things around at the struggling company.
cards.exUz: Yangi menejer kurashayotgan kompaniyadagi vaziyatni o'zgartira oldi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni yaxshilash, yomon holatdan yaxshi holatga olib kelish.
